samples.summary: Non-envelope upstream bodies now discard the backend's diagnostic message
samples.evidence: `forwardUpstreamError` throws `new Error(\`HTTP ${res.status}\`)` for any body that is not the documented envelope. Every backend error other than TYPE_MISMATCH is a Nest default body — I grepped packages/backend/src and the only object-bodied HttpException is `TYPE_MISMATCH_BODY` (docs-content.controller.ts:42); `getDocumentOrThrow` produces `{message:'…not found', error:'Not Found', statusCode:404}`. Previously the CLI printed that body (wrong shape, but it carried the reason); now `docs/slides/notes content|export` emit only `{"error":{"code":"ERROR","message":"HTTP 404"}}`, losing the upstream message on the most common failure (missing/forbidden document). Folding a string `body.message` into the thrown Error would keep the documented shape *and* the diagnostic.

samples.summary: Sibling path still forwards an unvalidated upstream body verbatim (bypasses the new guard)
samples.evidence: `runFilesDownload` does `io.stderr(JSON.stringify(res.data ?? { error: { code: 'HTTP_ERROR' } }, null, 2))` for any `!res.ok`, with no envelope check. `HttpClient.downloadFileDocument` (http-client.ts:261-267) puts the raw parsed body into `data`, so an Express/Nest 404 body reaches stderr as `{message,error:'Not Found',statusCode}` — exactly the shape this change set out to stop emitting. The task doc lists files/ as a non-goal, so this is a scope note rather than a defect introduced here, but the documented error contract is still violated on this path.

samples.summary: Envelope guard checks `code` only, so a body missing `message` is still forwarded as documented-shaped
samples.evidence: `isErrorEnvelope` requires only `typeof err.code === 'string'`; `{error:{code:'X'}}` is forwarded verbatim and reaches stderr with `message` absent, while packages/cli/README.md:116-120 documents `{"error":{"code":"…","message":"…"}}`. The test at packages/cli/test/upstream-error.test.ts:38 (`{code:'X',message:'m',…}`) does not cover the missing-message case. Consumers relying on `message` get `undefined` — the same class of silent shape breakage the change is fixing, just narrower.
